text:
{
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "characters": [
    {
      "id": "CHAR_ARTIE",
      "name": "Artie",
      "role": "protagonist",
      "description": "A tech-support worker turned system exploiter."
    },
    {
      "id": "CHAR_GUARD_CAPTAIN",
      "name": "Captain Kaelen",
      "role": "antagonist",
      "description": "A high-level scripted NPC in charge of tutorial security."
    },
    {
      "id": "CHAR_ADMINISTRATOR",
      "name": "Admin Xyla",
      "role": "antagonist",
      "description": "The regional system administrator tasked with bug fixing."
    },
    {
      "id": "CHAR_SENTINEL",
      "name": "Sentinel Unit 01",
      "role": "antagonist",
      "description": "A mindless system enforcement construct."
    }
  ],
  "threads": [
    {
      "id": "THREAD_SURVIVAL",
      "title": "Survival of the Glitched",
      "description": "Artie's ongoing struggle to maintain health and stability."
    },
    {
      "id": "THREAD_EXPLOIT",
      "title": "The Great Tax Evasion",
      "description": "The pursuit of illegal multipliers and items."
    },
    {
      "id": "THREAD_SYSTEM_HUNT",
      "title": "Under the Radar",
      "description": "Evading the System's automated deletion protocols."
    }
  ],
  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "Error 404: Hero Not Found",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Final Five O'Clock",
          "end_condition": "Artie's physical body is destroyed in a freak server-room collapse.",
          "intent": "Establish Artie's mundane life and the catastrophic accident that triggers the transition.",
          "target_scene_count": 2,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie is trapped in the server room as the earthquake begins.",
              "location_start_label": "Tech-Corp Server Room",
              "location_end_label": "Tech-Corp Server Room",
              "location_start": "A high-density server room with rows of humming racks and chilled air.",
              "location_end": "The same server room, now rattling under the first tremors of an earthquake.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie checks the diagnostic logs one last time before his shift ends.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "glowing monitor",
                "keyboard",
                "plastic chair"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "The floor begins to vibrate violently, throwing Artie against the wall.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "cracking floor",
                "falling servers",
                "emergency lights"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie's physical body is destroyed in a freak server-room collapse.",
              "location_start_label": "Tech-Corp Server Room",
              "location_end_label": "Void Transition",
              "location_start": "The collapsing server room filled with dust and sparks.",
              "location_end": "A pitch-black metaphysical space between life and the system.",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "Ceiling tiles collapse as the building groans under the seismic pressure.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "concrete dust",
                "exposed wiring",
                "blackness"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "transition_out_text": "Consciousness fades into a sea of flickering blue code.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "blue code",
                "silent void",
                "fading light"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie's physical body is destroyed in a freak server-room collapse."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Buffer Overflow",
          "end_condition": "Artie triggers a recursive logic loop in the stat allocation menu.",
          "intent": "Depict the character creation suite glitching as Artie's consciousness attempts to load.",
          "target_scene_count": 3,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "exploration",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes he is in a character creation menu with corrupted data.",
              "location_start_label": "Character Creation Suite",
              "location_end_label": "Character Creation Suite",
              "location_start": "A blinding white space filled with floating holographic menus.",
              "location_end": "The same white space, now showing flickering 'Error' messages.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie wakes up in a blinding white space filled with floating menus.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "floating text",
                "blue interface",
                "stat bars"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "transition_out_text": "He reaches out to touch a stat bar that is vibrating at an impossible frequency.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "vibrating bar",
                "holographic light",
                "digital hum"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie successfully manipulates the junk data to boost his Luck stat.",
              "location_start_label": "Character Creation Suite",
              "location_end_label": "Character Creation Suite",
              "location_start": "The character creation menu, currently displaying a Luck stat of 'NaN'.",
              "location_end": "The menu, now showing Luck as a rapidly changing hexadecimal value.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie drags a corrupted data fragment over his Luck attribute.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "data fragment",
                "luck attribute",
                "hexadecimal values"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "transition_out_text": "The entire UI begins to stutter as the logic fails to resolve the new value.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "stuttering UI",
                "logic error",
                "flashing red"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie triggers a recursive logic loop in the stat allocation menu.",
              "location_start_label": "Character Creation Suite",
              "location_end_label": "System Loading Screen",
              "location_start": "The character creation suite, now collapsing under a logic loop.",
              "location_end": "A black loading screen with a frozen progress bar.",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie confirms the corrupted build, forcing the system to accept the 'NaN' value.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "confirm button",
                "recursive loop",
                "frozen progress bar"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "transition_out_text": "The white void shatters like glass, dropping him into the game world.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "shattered glass",
                "falling sensation",
                "rushing wind"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie triggers a recursive logic loop in the stat allocation menu."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Spawn Point Error",
          "end_condition": "Artie spawns into the tutorial zone with a stat sheet that shouldn't exist.",
          "intent": "Artie finalizes his 'corrupted' build and enters the game world.",
          "target_scene_count": 3,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "exploration",
              "outcome": "Artie's avatar begins to render with visible visual artifacts.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Zone - Arrival Point",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Zone - Arrival Point",
              "location_start": "A peaceful dirt path surrounded by wooden fences and green fields.",
              "location_end": "The same path, but the grass is flickering in and out of existence.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie hits the ground hard, his hands flickering between solid and wireframe.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "dirt path",
                "wireframe hands",
                "flickering grass"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_out_text": "A system message appears, attempting to run a repair protocol.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "system message",
                "repair protocol",
                "red text"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The system repair fails, cementing Artie's glitched stats.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Zone - Arrival Point",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Zone - Arrival Point",
              "location_start": "The arrival point, now filled with floating error logs.",
              "location_end": "The arrival point, now quiet as the system gives up the repair.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie bats away the repair notifications, laughing at the absurdity.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "error logs",
                "notification sound",
                "digital debris"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_out_text": "He stands up and checks his character sheet one last time.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "character sheet",
                "luck stat",
                "solid ground"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "exploration",
              "outcome": "Artie spawns into the tutorial zone with a stat sheet that shouldn't exist.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Zone - Arrival Point",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Zone - Arrival Point",
              "location_start": "The peaceful arrival point, now fully rendered despite the glitches.",
              "location_end": "The arrival point, looking out towards the tutorial village.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The world snaps into focus as the tutorial loading screen finally clears.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "bright sunlight",
                "wooden fence",
                "distant village"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie takes his first step into the game world, ready to break it.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "first step",
                "dirt path",
                "tutorial start"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:1",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie spawns into the tutorial zone with a stat sheet that shouldn't exist."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "The Tutorial Tax Evasion",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Quest Log Exploits",
          "end_condition": "Artie identifies a repeatable quest that fails to check for completion flags.",
          "intent": "Artie identifies the first major flaw in the tutorial's quest-completion logic.",
          "target_scene_count": 3,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "exploration",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the tutorial village and receives his first quest.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_start": "A quaint village square with a well and several quest-giving NPCs.",
              "location_end": "The square, now bustling with low-level players and NPCs.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie walks into the village, his high Luck stat already causing NPCs to stare.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "village square",
                "stone well",
                "quest NPCs"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "transition_out_text": "He approaches the village elder, who has a glowing yellow exclamation mark.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "village elder",
                "quest mark",
                "yellow glow"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes the quest 'Collect 5 Berries' can be completed without losing the berries.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Village - Berry Bushes",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_start": "A small patch of bushes on the edge of the village.",
              "location_end": "The village elder's porch.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie picks the berries, but notices they don't leave his inventory when he turns them in.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "red berries",
                "inventory slot",
                "elder's porch"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "transition_out_text": "The elder thanks him, but the quest doesn't disappear from his log.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "quest log",
                "elder's thanks",
                "repeatable prompt"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies a repeatable quest that fails to check for completion flags.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_start": "The elder's porch, where the quest turn-in logic is broken.",
              "location_end": "The porch, now the site of Artie's first major exploit.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie turns the quest in again, and again, watching his XP bar tick up.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "XP bar",
                "level up",
                "broken flag"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "transition_out_text": "He grins as he realizes the system is failing to mark the quest as 'Done'.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "grinning face",
                "system failure",
                "infinite XP"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie identifies a repeatable quest that fails to check for completion flags."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Compounding Interest",
          "end_condition": "Artie achieves a x1000 reward multiplier on a hidden tutorial achievement.",
          "intent": "Artie grinds the exploit to stack illegal reward multipliers.",
          "target_scene_count": 4,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers that consecutive turn-ins trigger a 'Hidden Effort' multiplier.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_start": "The village square, now quiet as other players move on.",
              "location_end": "The square, where Artie is still talking to the elder.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie continues the cycle, his movements becoming a blur of efficiency.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "blur of motion",
                "efficiency",
                "cycle"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "transition_out_text": "A new notification pops up: 'Hidden Achievement: Persistent Gatherer'.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "hidden achievement",
                "multiplier",
                "gold text"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "The multiplier begins to stack exponentially due to his glitched Luck.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_start": "The square, where the multiplier is now x10.",
              "location_end": "The square, where the multiplier is now x100.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The Luck stat intervenes, turning a linear bonus into an exponential one.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "exponential growth",
                "luck intervention",
                "flashing numbers"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "transition_out_text": "The XP notifications are now screaming at him in a rapid-fire sequence.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "rapid-fire",
                "XP scream",
                "leveling sound"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie reaches the soft-cap for tutorial rewards but pushes past it.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_start": "The square, where the system is trying to cap the rewards.",
              "location_end": "The square, where the cap is bypassed.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A warning message appears: 'Reward Cap Reached'. Artie ignores it.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "warning message",
                "reward cap",
                "ignore prompt"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "transition_out_text": "The multiplier continues to climb as the system's logic breaks down.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "broken logic",
                "climbing multiplier",
                "digital static"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie achieves a x1000 reward multiplier on a hidden tutorial achievement.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Village - Main Square",
              "location_start": "The village square, now glowing with a golden achievement aura.",
              "location_end": "The square, where the exploit is finally complete.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The final turn-in triggers a screen-shaking explosion of gold light.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "gold light",
                "screen shake",
                "x1000 multiplier"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie stands in the center of the square, bathed in the light of an illegal achievement.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "achievement aura",
                "illegal light",
                "silent square"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie achieves a x1000 reward multiplier on a hidden tutorial achievement."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Golden Handshake",
          "end_condition": "Artie exits the tutorial zone carrying a legendary-tier inventory item.",
          "intent": "Artie collects the massive payout and prepares to leave the starting zone.",
          "target_scene_count": 3,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie receives the 'Tutorial Master's Ring', which has glitched stats.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Village - Reward Altar",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Village - Reward Altar",
              "location_start": "A small stone altar where achievement rewards are dispensed.",
              "location_end": "The altar, now holding a glowing legendary ring.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The system, confused by the x1000 multiplier, generates a reward from the wrong loot table.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "loot table",
                "stone altar",
                "legendary ring"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "transition_out_text": "He picks up the ring, and the tool-tip is a mess of question marks.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "question marks",
                "tool-tip",
                "legendary tier"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "type": "exploration",
              "outcome": "Artie organizes his inventory, now overflowing with high-tier consumables.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Village - Outskirts",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Village - Outskirts",
              "location_start": "The edge of the village, looking out toward the main world.",
              "location_end": "The same spot, with Artie's inventory looking very crowded.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie sorts through his bags, which are stuffed with more gold and potions than the tutorial should allow.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "stuffed bags",
                "gold coins",
                "health potions"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "transition_out_text": "He looks toward the exit gate, where the tutorial's protection ends.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "exit gate",
                "protection zone",
                "main world"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "2:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie exits the tutorial zone carrying a legendary-tier inventory item.",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Zone - Exit Gate",
              "location_end_label": "The Open World - Plains",
              "location_start": "The shimmering blue barrier at the end of the tutorial.",
              "location_end": "The vast, open plains of the main game world.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie steps through the barrier, the legendary ring glinting on his finger.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "blue barrier",
                "glinting ring",
                "open plains"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:9",
              "transition_out_text": "The tutorial is behind him, but the system is already starting to flag his presence.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "system flag",
                "tutorial exit",
                "new horizon"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "3:1",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie exits the tutorial zone carrying a legendary-tier inventory item."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 3,
      "title": "The Level One Menace",
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Stop Right There",
          "end_condition": "Artie is cornered by the scripted Guard Captain for unauthorized entry.",
          "intent": "The local authorities attempt to process Artie's anomalous presence.",
          "target_scene_count": 3,
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "type": "exploration",
              "outcome": "Artie arrives at the gates of the capital city, Oakhaven.",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven - City Gates",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven - City Gates",
              "location_start": "Massive stone gates guarded by high-level NPCs.",
              "location_end": "The gatehouse, where the guards are checking levels.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie walks up to the gate, his level 1 tag floating above his head.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "stone gates",
                "level tag",
                "gate guards"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:10",
              "transition_out_text": "The guards' eyes widen as they see his legendary ring.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "widened eyes",
                "legendary ring",
                "suspicious guards"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "3:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie is flagged as an 'Unauthorized Entity' by the city's scanners.",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven - Gatehouse",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven - Gatehouse",
              "location_start": "The interior of the gatehouse, filled with magical sensors.",
              "location_end": "The gatehouse, now flashing with red alarm lights.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "pursued",
              "transition_in_text": "A magical scanner sweeps over Artie, and immediately starts screaming.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "magical scanner",
                "alarm light",
                "screaming siren"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:1",
              "transition_out_text": "The guards draw their swords, and a heavy footfall echoes from the city.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "drawn swords",
                "heavy footfall",
                "approaching threat"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "3:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie is cornered by the scripted Guard Captain for unauthorized entry.",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven - Gatehouse",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven - Gatehouse",
              "location_start": "The gatehouse, surrounded by guards.",
              "location_end": "The gatehouse, with Captain Kaelen blocking the exit.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "detained",
              "transition_in_text": "Captain Kaelen steps forward, his level 50 tag a terrifying contrast to Artie's level 1.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "Captain Kaelen",
                "level 50",
                "blocking exit"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "3:2",
              "transition_out_text": "Kaelen points his spear at Artie's chest. 'You don't belong here, bug.'",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "spear point",
                "bug",
                "cornered"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "3:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie is cornered by the scripted Guard Captain for unauthorized entry."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
